question: On the frozen 9-slot low-prior-ATR V1.7 account with a 75% resting partial and 25% unchanged cloud runner, does the original opposite weekly 1.618 reference improve on the fixed 2R partial when the 75% target is placed at a preregistered fraction of the remaining confirmation-entry-to-extension distance?
single_variable: resting target geometry for the 75% partial; entries, stops, 25% runner, account allocation, controls, and fees are frozen

account.priority_feature: frozen signal prior_atr_pct ascending; simultaneous order matches the selected parent account
account.entry: frozen exact next-1H-open fill at each completed UTC 12H confirmation
account.stop: exact per-event original touched-side 1.618 stop from the frozen path input

target_geometry.signal: target = actual_confirmation_entry + fraction * (original_opposite_weekly_1p618_reference - actual_confirmation_entry), after verifying the reference remains favorable from entry
target_geometry.control: transfer the parent reference-to-parent-actual-entry price ratio to the control entry, then apply the same fraction
target_geometry.fallback: if the event's opposite reference is already at or beyond the entry in the adverse direction, use the original fixed 2R target for that event in every candidate; if any projected resting limit price is zero or negative, submit no target order and let that 75% leg follow the unchanged runner
target_geometry.risk_denominator: original entry-to-stop distance; the vectorized path adapter's synthetic target distance is not used as trade risk
target_geometry.scaleout_adapter_sentinel: new target path rows use tp_r=2 only to enter the existing 75/25 target-runner pair adapter; target_fraction and target_price are the actual candidate geometry

selection.pick: among eligible frozen fixed_2r and four preregistered extension geometries, highest development account multiple; if none qualify retain fixed_2r
selection.best_dev_growth: highest development account multiple regardless of qualification

costs.entry_stop_runner: market/taker; the parent path fee class is reused unchanged

execution.framework: VectorBT Portfolio.from_order_func via cloud_close_reward_paths._simulate_symbol and existing wallet cash-sharing account
execution.new_path_generation: sequential by symbol; four target alternatives batched in event chunks of 8; no data download or parent rerun
execution.accounting: existing cloud_close_slots.run and cloud_close_scaleout.pair_data/simulate with full 1000U shared account
execution.fallback_path_parity: assert orderable passed-extension fallbacks match frozen fixed-2R paths and nonpositive projected prices match frozen 0R runner paths, including matched controls

limits.fills: OHLC target touches are modeled as filled resting limits at the level; queue position and non-fill probability are not represented
limits.liquidation: exchange-specific maintenance-margin tiers and liquidation are outside this exit-geometry study
